emergence.summary: The commonest urea-cycle disorder. Ornithine transcarbamylase (OTC), the mitochondrial enzyme that condenses carbamoyl phosphate with ornithine to make citrulline, is the second committed step of the urea cycle that disposes of waste nitrogen as urea. OTC loss-of-function STALLS the cycle, so ammonia (and its upstream carrier glutamine) is no longer cleared and the toxic waste-nitrogen burden is driven UP -> hyperammonaemia (neonatal encephalopathy in hemizygous males; episodic decompensation in heterozygous females). Read as a released BRAKE on ammonia accumulation (OTC brakes the build-up by feeding the detoxifying cycle; LOF releases it -> burden UP) -- the tyrosinaemia / porphyria toxic-metabolite pattern. The kit re-derives the approved therapy, which RESTRAINS the waste-nitrogen burden rather than restoring OTC: nitrogen scavengers (glycerol phenylbutyrate; sodium phenylbutyrate; sodium benzoate + sodium phenylacetate) open an alternative excretion route (phenylacetate conjugates glutamine to phenylacetylglutamine; benzoate conjugates glycine to hippurate; both excreted in urine), and urea-cycle substrate repletion (citrulline / arginine) feeds the distal cycle past the block; both lower the ammonia burden. Restoring OTC itself (liver transplantation, the definitive correction; AAV-OTC / OTC-mRNA gene therapy investigational) is the function-restoring lever. The gamma read is of the OTC locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesion is coding/splice (e.g. the milder late-onset Arg40His missense allele), outside the promoter firewall. X-linked (Xp11.4), so penetrance/severity are zygosity- and X-inactivation-dependent and held [O] (the B10 X-linked caveat). Magnitude [O].

per_gene.note: OTC (ornithine transcarbamylase) is the mitochondrial enzyme catalysing carbamoyl phosphate + ornithine -> citrulline, the second step of the urea cycle that detoxifies ammonia. As a BRAKE on waste-nitrogen accumulation, its LOF RELEASES the brake -> the cycle stalls and ammonia/glutamine accumulate -> the toxic waste-nitrogen burden goes UP. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding/splice lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the TOXIC WASTE-NITROGEN BURDEN (it goes UP), so the corrective levers LOWER it. X-linked (Xp11.4).

levers.mechanism_grade: [O] ammonia-lowering magnitude not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: replete the distal urea-cycle intermediate pool (citrulline / arginine) so residual cycle flux past the OTC block proceeds -> lower the ammonia burden

falsifiers.claim: OTC LOF (released brake) raises the toxic waste-nitrogen burden (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: an OTC deficiency allele that LOWERED plasma ammonia / glutamine would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma ammonia and glutamine by OTC genotype / hemizygosity

falsifiers.claim: diverting waste nitrogen (scavenger) or repleting the distal cycle (citrulline/arginine) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the burden)
falsifiers.falsifier: if a nitrogen scavenger or citrulline/arginine repletion RAISED or failed to lower plasma ammonia, the restrain lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma ammonia response to nitrogen-scavenger therapy or to citrulline/arginine repletion
